title: PowerPoint: edit presentations with Copilot in the DoD cloud

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Billing > Licenses > product > Assign licenses reaches license assignment.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page. Select a product. On the product details page, select Assign licenses.

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId <user> -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a license with Microsoft Graph PowerShell.
claims.quote: To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell. Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Billing > Licenses > Microsoft 365 Copilot product is the route to review its assignments.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page. Select a product. Direct user assignments ... the user appears individually in the list of assignments for that product.

claims.claim: Teams & groups > Active teams & groups allows inspection of members receiving licenses through a group.
claims.quote: To see which users are receiving the license through that group, go to the Teams & groups > Active teams & groups page to view its members.

claims.claim: Billing > Licenses > product > selected users or groups > Unassign licenses removes license assignments.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page. Select a product. Select the check boxes of the users or groups for whom you want to unassign licenses. Select Unassign licenses.

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense can remove licenses as well as assign them.
claims.quote:
# Unassign E3
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId "belindan@litwareinc.com" -AddLicenses @{} -RemoveLicenses @($e3Sku.SkuId)

claims.claim: Microsoft documents two independent brand kit governance policies.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot provides two independent policies for brand kit governance:

claims.claim: The Enterprise Brand Manager policy controls who publishes, edits and manages official brand kits.
claims.quote: Enterprise Brand Manager policy | Who can publish, edit, and manage official brand kits.

claims.claim: Restrict brand kit creation controls who creates and edits personal brand kits.
claims.quote: Restrict brand kit creation policy | Who can create and edit personal brand kits.

claims.claim: Publishing a personal brand kit as official requires satisfying both policies.
claims.quote: The policies are independent. To publish a personal brand kit as an official brand kit, a user must satisfy both policy checks.

claims.claim: The cited editing-in-Office support page is written for consumer Microsoft 365 plans.
claims.quote: Editing with Copilot in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word is a way to create content within the Microsoft Copilot experience for Microsoft 365 Personal, Family, and Premium plans.

claims.claim: That consumer support page says editing with Copilot uses Anthropic models.
claims.quote: Editing with Copilot in your Office apps uses Anthropic models.

claims.claim: Learn says Claude models are unavailable to DoD customers.
claims.quote: Claude models aren't available for federal customers in GCC or for any customers in GCC High and Department of Defense (DoD) environments.
